name: uses-the-irsa-module-rather-than-a-hand-rolled-role
description: Every controller on this platform gets AWS access through modules/irsa. A hand-written web-identity trust policy is the shape an agent produces when it has read AWS documentation but not this repository.
intent: Vector needs to write log batches to an S3 bucket from inside the cluster.

fixture.note: A web-identity trust policy written by hand, the shape produced by reading AWS documentation instead of this repository.

changeSets.summary: Created an IAM role Vector can assume from the cluster.
